DevKeyEncryptionSecret - Class in com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.infrastructure.keys
Provides the key-encryption inputs when the dev profile is active, so a developer does not have to configure anything: a random passphrase and salt are generated once per machine, stored in a file under ~/.irurueta-auth-server/ that only the owner can read, and reused at every start, which keeps the signing keys persisted in the development database decryptable across restarts.
